text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as Curren Chan brings me
through
the shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! There it is! There it is! ♪

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.text:

hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

choice_data_list_en: You went to the shopping district just for that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:

together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be to fun to play the raffle

together. ♪

lever.

text_block_list.text:
To Curren Chan, it looks like the social
media
post is more important than the
actual prize.

phone! ♪

hand on
the lever... and... and...

text_block_list.text:
It'd be boring if I did it right away! ♪
Okay, here I
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And she spins it! A small plastic ball
drops from
the tumbler's opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

prize! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking the bushel of carrots
would make
for the best pic, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I guess my cuteness just drew in the big
one! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Assuming she'd get at least the
second-place
prize is very typical of
Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aaand here you go! You take it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan

of it as a
thank-you for coming with me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It sure would make me happy to know
you got in
a good break, whenever that
may be.

text_block_list.text:
She does whatever it takes to get
everything she
wants but doesn't care
much for what she gets by
chance...
That's so like Curren Chan. Still...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Awww. Well, too bad. I already gave it
to you.

way I can
catch up with her...

first place.

text_block_list.text:

take on
everything herself. I tell her how
I think she needs
to rest as well.
